本文记录老年上海观光团（SST, Shanghai Senior Tour）参加: This report documents our team's participation as SST (Shanghai Senior Tour) in the grand finals of the Robbyant Embodied AI Challenge, covering model tuning, experimental analysis, and reflections after the competition.

The model already completes most tasks in familiar scenes, but changes to backgrounds, lighting, and distractors substantially reduce its success rate.
At 15k, success reaches 77.1% in Clean scenes but only 36.2% in Randomized scenes. Training to 20k raises Clean to 79.6% without improving Randomized performance. This shifts our focus to inputs and supervision: how can we make learned manipulation skills less sensitive to scene appearance?

新增信息的接入应优先保持 VLM 原生的注意力形式。Causal 保留了预训练时: New information should be integrated in a way that preserves the VLM's native attention pattern. Causal attention retains the token-visibility relationships used during pretraining. Although pair enables more information exchange between the original and SAM images, it also changes those relationships and performs worse. Matching native attention deserves priority over designing more elaborate positional encodings.

这组实验同样从 N0 出发，保持全部原图输入，把 SAM 信息从后端的 Meta: This experiment also starts from N0, retaining all original image inputs and introducing SAM information through auxiliary MetaQuery supervision. Learnable queries read image and language tokens under causal attention, then predict reviewed masks through a MaskFormer-style dot product. The action expert can also read these queries. We include both N0 and N2 below to compare auxiliary supervision with direct input processing.
策略仍输入三张原图。图像和语言 token 后插入可学习 SAM Query，再: The policy still receives three original images. Learnable SAM queries are inserted after image and language tokens and before the existing depth/video queries; the full VLM prefix uses causal attention. The action expert can read the SAM queries, which remain at inference. A training-only type-B mask head projects main-view hidden states to pixel embeddings F and SAM-query hidden states to mask embeddings e. A dot product followed by a maximum over queries produces 32×32 mask logits, supervised with BCE and Dice losses against offline SAM targets. The mask head and losses are removed at inference.

这两类方案都希望为 VLA 增加前景信息，区别在于接入位置：输入侧方案在推理时直: Both approaches aim to add foreground information to the VLA, but introduce it at different points. 输入处理之外，我们也考察优化过程。LingBot-VLA 2.0 的默认学习率在: Beyond input processing, we also examine optimization. LingBot-VLA 2.0's default learning rate decays from 1e−4 to 5e−5 over 50k steps. We consider this relatively high for post-training, so our experiments focus on reducing it: first by decaying to a lower endpoint within 30k steps, and then by also lowering the initial rate.
更快衰减的 lr_1 在 15k 和 30k 都低于默认配置；初始学习率更小的: The faster-decaying lr_1 underperforms the default at both 15k and 30k. With its lower initial learning rate, lr_2 achieves only 19.5% at 15k. Uniformly reducing updates to all parameters is not effective under the current training budget.
保留基础学习率调度，进一步按模块控制更新幅度。: Retain the base schedule and control update magnitudes separately for each module.
分模块学习率：减少预训练表征的更新: Module-wise learning rates: update pretrained representations less

视觉、语言与动作模块承担不同角色，也具有不同的预训练基础。我们希望视觉语言模块保: Vision, language, and action modules have different roles and different pretraining histories. We want the vision-language modules to preserve more of their existing representations while allowing action and alignment modules to keep adapting to the downstream tasks. We therefore assign different learning-rate multipliers to each module.

15k 和 25k 时，Randomized 都提高了约 2.2 个百分点。与统: Randomized success improves by about 2.2 points at both 15k and 25k. Compared with lowering every module's learning rate together, controlling updates by module better balances retention of pretrained representations and downstream adaptation.
分模块学习率进入最终方案。: Module-wise learning rates become part of the final recipe.

只对两个腕部相机施加训练时的光度与颜色增强。: Apply photometric and color augmentations to the two wrist-camera images during training only.
主视角已经经过前景处理，剩余的外观差异可能来自腕部相机。我们根据随机场景的光照统: With foreground processing already applied to the main view, the remaining appearance differences may come from the wrist cameras. We set augmentation ranges using lighting statistics from randomized scenes and perturb brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, gamma, and noise. Both wrist cameras share the same sampled lighting perturbation.
Randomized success does not improve at 15k or 25k, although at 20k it rises from 53.8% to 55.8%. Results vary across checkpoints, and Clean performance also declines. We do not observe a clear, consistent benefit.
测试进行到这里时，已经临近初赛结束，因此我们选择关闭腕部增强。当然，也不能排除训: By this stage, the preliminary-round deadline was approaching, so we chose to disable wrist augmentation. We cannot rule out that more training would have been needed to realize its benefits.

Padding action 参与了监督: Padded actions were included in supervision

The original loss supervises these padded positions too, potentially overemphasizing the final hold action. We combine a padding mask with the valid-joint mask to exclude padded positions from both the loss numerator and its normalization denominator.

提供一种通过视觉 prompt 连接 System 1 与 System 2 的: Connect System 1 and System 2 through visual prompts.
优先从输入侧接入新信息: Make new information directly available at the input
同样从原图基线出发，保留 causal attention 的 SAM 第四视角: Starting from the same original-image baseline, a fourth SAM view with causal attention outperforms auxiliary MetaQuery supervision. Replacing the main view with the foreground image works better still. On these tasks, making foreground information directly available during action prediction translates into manipulation gains more readily than shaping representations through a mask-reconstruction objective alone. When adding task-relevant information to a VLA, prioritize whether the policy can use it directly at inference.
增加输入时，优先保留 VLM 原生的注意力形式: Preserve native VLM attention when adding inputs
在第四视角实验中，三种位置编码在 causal 设置下仅相差约 1.3 个百分点: In the fourth-view experiments, the three positional encodings differ by only about 1.3 percentage points under causal attention. Switching to pair attention with the same encoding consistently reduces success by 2.6–5.0 points. New tokens add information, but they can also change how a pretrained model exchanges it. Before refining positional encodings for new content, first preserve the token-visibility relationships of the VLM's native causal attention.
按模块分配学习率，平衡能力保留与任务适应: Balance retention and adaptation with module-wise learning rates
统一降低学习率没有带来收益；降低 ViT、visual merger 与 LLM: Uniformly lowering the learning rate does not help. Lowering the rates for the ViT, visual merger, and LLM, freezing token embeddings, and retaining the update scale for action and alignment modules instead improves Randomized success by about 2.2 percentage points at both 15k and 25k. Modules need not change at the same rate during post-training: extensively pretrained modules whose representations we want to retain should use lower learning rates, or be frozen when appropriate, while modules responsible for downstream adaptation need sufficient room to update.
排除 padding action，避免把补齐动作当作任务监督: Exclude padded actions from task supervision
Padding 是为了统一动作块长度引入的人工补齐，并不代表真实的决策轨迹。对于: Padding is an artificial device for making action chunks the same length, not part of the demonstrated decision trajectory. For a VLA without memory or history in RoboTwin, repeatedly supervising end-of-episode hold actions may associate similar current observations with both continuing execution and remaining still. This can amplify ambiguity between a task that is still in progress and one that has finished. Padded actions should therefore be excluded from both the loss and its normalization denominator, so the model learns only from valid actions.
将感知模型的迁移能力转化为 VLA 的视觉指导: Turn perception-model generalization into visual guidance for a VLA
现有 VLM 与视频分割模型的跨场景物体定位、前景提取能力，可以通过视觉 pro: The ability of existing VLMs and video segmentation models to locate objects and extract foreground regions across scenes can provide effective guidance to a VLA through visual prompts. Our Qwen-SAM pipeline uses Qwen to interpret the instruction and identify relevant objects, then SAM to extract the foreground. In RoboTwin's clean-to-randomized setting, where the shift is primarily in scene appearance, SAM multi foreground inputs raise Randomized success from 36.2% to 47.8%; mask review and rendering adjustments bring it to 50.8%. These experiments demonstrate the pipeline's effectiveness in this transfer setting and offer a concrete way to connect System 1 and System 2 through visual prompts.
